concept_uz: Chorsu bozorida olti sotuvchi bir qatorda turibdi. Har biri yo doim rost, yo doim yolgʻon gapiradi — va har biri bittadan gap aytadi. Olti gapdan keyin bozor muzlab qoladi: kim rostgoʻy? Javob keyingi hafta, 19-oktabrdan keyin.

facts.claim: Olti sotuvchi, rastalar 1–6: ziravor, qovun, non, quruq meva, asal, Chust pichoqlari

style_line: Cinematic photoreal, bright late-morning sun under a market awning, warm saturated colours of spices, melons and honey, 35mm film look, lively Central Asian bazaar mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

refs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 shot of one straight row of six small wooden market stalls under a shared canvas awning in an old Tashkent bazaar, a blue-tiled dome in the soft background. From left to right: 1 heaps of red, yellow and brown spices in bowls; 2 a pile of long yellow melons; 3 a stack of round patterned flatbreads; 4 baskets of raisins, dried apricots and nuts; 5 glass jars of golden honey with a honeycomb; 6 a rack of curved knives with carved handles. No people, no signs.

Add one seller behind each of the six stalls, all facing the camera, same stalls, same light, 9:16. 1 spices: a thin elderly man of about 65 with a white beard and a bright ORANGE skullcap. 2 melons: a big round jolly man of about 45 in a striped BLUE-AND-WHITE robe. 3 bread: a young woman of about 30 with a YELLOW headscarf, white apron and floury hands. 4 dried fruit: a woman of about 55 in a PURPLE atlas-silk dress with gold earrings. 5 honey: a young man of about 25 in a GREEN vest holding a wooden honey dipper. 6 knives: a man of about 40 with a grey moustache, a RED headband and a black leather apron. No signs, no numbers.

Change the framing: a medium two-shot of only the first two stalls and their sellers, the old spice seller in the orange skullcap and the big melon seller in the striped blue-and-white robe, side by side. Same faces, same clothes, same light, 9:16.

lines.text: Toshkent, Chorsu. Olti sotuvchi. Baʼzilari doim rost gapiradi, qolganlari — doim yolgʻon.

scenes.prompt: Fast push-in along the row of six market stalls as all six sellers shout and wave at the camera at once, a melon is tossed in the air and caught, spice dust puffs up in the sunlight. Audio: loud bazaar hubbub, a donkey cart bell, the shouting stops suddenly. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Toshkent, Chorsu. Olti sotuvchi. Ba'zilari doim rost gapiradi, qolganlari — doim yolg'on.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Rastalar birdan oltigacha: ziravor, qovun, non, quruq meva, asal va Chust pichoqlari.

scenes.prompt: Slow sideways tracking shot from left to right past the six stalls in order: spices, melons, bread, dried fruit, honey, knives; each seller gives a small nod as the camera passes. Audio: soft bazaar murmur, a knife being sharpened, bees humming near the honey. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Rastalar birdan oltigacha: ziravor, qovun, non, quruq meva, asal va Chust pichoqlari.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Ziravorchi bilan asalchi bir xil toifada.

scenes.prompt: Two-shot of the first two stalls. The old spice seller in the orange skullcap points a bony finger at his neighbour; the big melon seller in the striped blue-and-white robe slaps a melon and points back toward the far end of the row. Comic timing. Audio: a melon slap, spice jars clinking. The spice seller says sharply in Uzbek with a raspy, sharp elderly male voice of about 65: "Qovunchi — yolg'onchi." Then the melon seller answers in Uzbek with a booming, jolly middle-aged male voice of about 45: "Ziravorchi bilan asalchi bir xil toifada.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Two-shot of the third and fourth stalls. The young baker woman in the yellow headscarf slams a round flatbread onto her stack with floury hands and nods toward the knife stall; the dried-fruit seller in the purple atlas dress pours raisins from a scoop and smiles knowingly toward the spice stall. Audio: bread thump, raisins rattling. The bread seller says in Uzbek with a brisk, clear young female voice of about 30: "Pichoqchi — yolg'onchi." Then the dried-fruit seller says in Uzbek with a soft, sly middle-aged female voice of about 55: "Ziravorchi — rostgo'y.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Qovunchi bilan quruq mevachi har xil toifada.

scenes.prompt: Two-shot of the last two stalls. The young honey seller in the green vest lifts a dripping honey dipper and counts slowly on three fingers; the knife seller in the red headband and black leather apron rests a knife on his whetstone and taps the counter twice. Audio: honey dripping, a bee, steel on stone. The honey seller says in Uzbek with a slow, calm young male voice of about 25: "Oltovimizdan roppa-rosa uchtasi rostgo'y." Then the knife seller says in Uzbek with a low, gravelly male voice of about 40: "Qovunchi bilan quruq mevachi har xil toifada.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Bir xil toifada — ikkalasi ham rostgoʻy yoki ikkalasi ham yolgʻonchi. Ularni ajratishning yagona yoʻli bor.

scenes.prompt: The six sellers slowly turn their heads and look at each other suspiciously along the row, eyebrows raised, arms folded; nobody speaks. Camera slowly rises above the stalls. Audio: the bazaar noise fades to a single wind gust. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Bir xil toifada — ikkalasi ham rostgo'y yoki ikkalasi ham yolg'onchi. Ularni ajratishning yagona yo'li bor.". No subtitles, no on-screen text.

lines.text: Kim rostgoʻy? Rostgoʻylarning rasta raqamlarini qoʻshing. Javobni izohda yozing yoki powerty.uz/logic da yuboring!

scenes.prompt: Slow pull-back from the row of six stalls; all six sellers freeze mid-gesture as if time stopped, a tossed apricot hangs still in the air. Hold on the frozen frame. Audio: total silence, then one soft bell. An off-screen narrator says in Uzbek with a calm, warm middle-aged male storyteller voice: "Kim rostgo'y? Rostgo'ylarning rasta raqamlarini qo'shing.
